## Parent / origin

Migrated from Bead `FPL-bsw.38` (was **in_progress**, priority 0 epic).
Parent epic: `FPL-bsw` (Benchmark Kernel).

## Status at migration

All **14 child beads are closed**. The epic remained in progress because it
retains ownership of the **prospective live initial-squad policy and human
approval contract**. Live initial-15 implementation was split to closed beads
`FPL-guz` (versioned optimiser checkpoint runner) and `FPL-jm0` (production-path
pre-GW1 rehearsal).

## What (residual)

Finish the prospective, point-in-time, reproducible, human-approved policy for
the 2026/27 starting 15 — without re-running sealed 2025/26 trajectories or
hindsight-tuning from early-season forks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] GW1 seed selection remains separated from GW2–GW11 weekly evidence.
- [ ] Canonical 2025/26 artifacts remain immutable.
- [ ] Isolated and longitudinal comparisons remain specified in evaluation docs.
- [ ] Live initial-squad policy is prospective, point-in-time, reproducible, and explicitly human-approved (owner sign-off recorded).
- [ ] Handoff / preregistration docs point at this GitHub Issue rather than the Bead.

## Blocked by

None for documentation/policy closure; owner approval is required to mark the
live initial-squad policy accepted.
